architecture.pattern: Command Pattern with Operational Transformation (OT) Dual-Stack
stack_classes: CollaborativeCommand (Collaborative transaction unit with pointer & vector)

memory_limits.gc_trigger: Trim on stack size > 100 and IndexedDB quota pressure

command_lifecycle.inversion: command.reverse() -> returns new Command with swapped undo/redo commands
command_lifecycle.merging: pushWithOperateId(operateId, item) -> merges continuous micro-actions (drag, resize, slider)
command_lifecycle.truncation: push() clears redoStack on new user action unless clearRedo=false

command_registry.description: Inserts image, text, shape, or sticker node into canvas tree
Removes one or more nodes from the stage
command_registry.undo_strategy: RESTORE_NODE at original z-index and coordinates

command_registry.description: Mutates node attributes (color, opacity, font, shadow, filters)
Changes x, y position, rotation, or scale bounds of nodes
Combines selected nodes into a parent Container/Group
Explodes Container/Group back to root canvas items
Resizes document bounds, changes DPI, background color or aspect ratio
